links.outcome: Rule-based triage decision accuracy on benchmark cases with escalation labels
links.effect: Triage-decision accuracy reached 80% on benchmark cases with escalation labels; error analysis found 5 triage decision errors and 26 routing errors; domain-routing accuracy 87%.
links.quote: Domain-routing accuracy reached 87%, and triage-decision accuracy reached 80% on benchmark cases containing escalation labels.

unlisted_practices: Lightweight retrieval-augmented generation with domain-aware routing and deterministic physician/OPD lookup for frontline workers
Sensitivity analysis of retrieval depth (k=1,3,5) and bootstrap confidence intervals

screen.reason: The paper develops and evaluates a lightweight RAG-based AI agent using an automated benchmark of 200 synthetic healthcare queries, without human users or testing of an external deployment safeguard practice.
